title: Control access, disclosure and correction of workforce data
requirements:
- Describe multisectoral, multistakeholder governance of the wider HRHIS, including private-sector participation and safeguards
- Use policy-based access by purpose, role and sensitivity
- Define record history apart from security audit
- Address the legal and data-protection basis
- Apply disclosure control to reports and exports
- Record corrections, disputes, decisions and appeals
- Define public and restricted data subsets
- Verify recipient authority for notifications
